name: Monchique Resort & Spa
description:
Surrounded by nature and views of the Algarve coast, Monchique Resort & Spa is located in the Serra de Monchique and features restaurants, 2 outdoor pools and a variety of Spa experiences. The resort features a program of activities that guests may enjoy for free.

The resort’s luxurious suites are elegant and beautifully appointed, offering a separate bedroom, large living room, two bathrooms and a balcony or terrace with outdoor furniture and some with stunning views over the mountains and coastline. Free of charge WiFi is available in all areas.

Each of the restaurants at the Monchique Resort & Spa offers a unique gastronomic experience. From award-winning fine dining through Neapolitan pizzeria and themed international and national buffet. The Mezzanine cocktail bar often has live entertainment (during high season) and the bars serve a variety of drinks and light snacks.

The Sensorial Spa features sauna, steam room, aromatherapy, an indoor heated pool (25€ per 2 hours for adult - children under 16 years old are not allowed) relaxation rooms, treatment rooms, we recommend to book it prior arrival directly with the Spa Team. 24-hour open Gym. Personalized training sessions can be booked, for a surcharge. Children between 5 and 12 years old are welcome at the on-site Kids Club available every day (during high season). Guests may book activities like jeep safaris, hiking, standup paddle and mountain biking with an additional fee.

The hotel is a 60-minute drive from Faro International Airport. It is only a 20-minute drive away from several beaches in the Portimão area, and a 15-minute drive away from the nearest golf course.

name: Wyndham Grand Algarve
description:
The Wyndham Grand Algarve is located in one of Portugal’s largest golf resorts and surrounded by the tranquility of Ria Formosa Nature Park. This recently renovated All-suite 5-Star hotel includes an adults only Spa and offers well-appointed accommodations, with all the mod cons.

Each Suite is creatively designed with focus on comfort and functionality. All suites boast furnished living rooms and balconies with views of landscaped gardens. The spacious Suites come equipped with HD TVs, kitchen supplies and the added comfort of five-star services and amenities. Free Wi-Fi is provided.

Guests can enjoy Breakfast at CARAVELA Restaurant overlooking the pool. The hotel provides a delicious menu focused on healthy signature dishes, salads, pizzas and burgers on the poolside outdoor terrace of the OÁSIS Poolside Café, where cool drinks and refreshing cocktails are served while guests indulge in the Algarve sun.
With a bistro chic concept, Wyndham Grand Algarve’s restaurant XXL Quinta do Lago by Olivier, overlooks the hotel gardens, and serves a dinner menu that exposes the union between respect for Portuguese cuisine traditions and the irreverence of restaurateur Olivier da Costa.
At the GRAND Bar & Lounge guests can have tasty bites while exploring the cocktails menu while listening to live music.

The GRAND Spa is available for adults only, offering a jacuzzi, sauna and offers relaxing massages and body treatments with Cinq Mondes signature.
Wyndham Grand Algarve also has a fully equipped GYM overlooking the hotel gardens.

Located in the heart of Quinta do Lago, Wyndham Grand Algarve is 20 minutes away from Faro International Airport and 2 hours away from Lisbon or Seville.
Nearby leisure activities include golf, beach, water sports, tennis, bike rides, horse riding and bird watching. Free private parking is available on site.

name: Jupiter Albufeira Hotel - Family & Fun - All Inclusive 24h
description:
The renovated 5-star Jupiter Albufeira Hotel - Family & Fun - All Inclusive 24h is located in the tranquil Montechoro area within a 10-minute drive from Oura Beach and Albufeira’s center. It features a water park, several outdoor pools, a Spa and a great all inclusive program.

All rooms feature a modern décor, a private balcony and a private bathroom with walk-in shower. Each is prepared to perfectly accommodate families with small children.

The hotel offers two buffet restaurants that serve continuous meals from breakfast through dinner. Additionally, guests who stay for a minimum of seven nights can enjoy one meal at the themed restaurants, Alecrim (à la carte) or Taberna (set menu).

The rooftop bar Al Gharb offers stunning views over Albufeira and the ocean, making it the perfect setting to end the day. The Spa is available for a surcharge and includes a sauna, a steam room and an indoor swimming pool. Guests can access the 24-hour fitness room for free.

A complimentary free shuttle service up to 2 to 6 times per day is provided to Albufeira’s old town center. Faro International Airport is 24 mi away.

name: Tivoli Carvoeiro
description:
Located in the picturesque town of Carvoeiro, overlooking Vale Covo, the 5-star Tivoli Carvoeiro offers high standards of quality, ideal for family holidays and memorable events.

The nearest beaches Carvoeiro & Centeanes are located around 2953 feet.

The rooms are spacious allowing superior comfort and convenience. With its elegant contemporary design, rooms are equipped with air conditioning, WiFi, a mini-bar, a TV, a desk and a bathroom with a shower.

The Med Food & Wine offers a rich variety of national and international flavors: freshly baked breads, croissants, fruits, an assortment of cheeses, and delectable cold cuts. Enjoy hot options such as eggs cooked just the way you like. We cater to everyone, with special options for children and gluten-free alternatives.

At the Tivoli Spa guests can enjoy a variety of treatments and find perfect balance in a memorable experience with its indoor pool, steam room and sauna. Tivoli Shape is a fitness center with advanced training equipment where guests can work out.

Tivoli Carvoeiro’s facilities include 6 meeting rooms, most of them with direct access to the green, and capacity for 900 guests. In addition, a wide range of services are available for children including activity plans overseen by professional monitors. The hotel is less than 5 minutes’ drive from Vale de Milho Golf Course and Slide and Splash is 3.1 mi away. Tivoli Carvoeiro is a 40-minute drive from Faro International Airport. Free on-site car parking is available.

name: Vila Vita Parc
description:
Vila Vita Parc is set on a clifftop overlooking the Atlantic Ocean. Located in Alporchinhos, it consists of Moorish-style buildings surrounded by tropical gardens.

The rooms feature a balcony or terrace where charming views of the Atlantic Ocean and Armação de Pêra can be admired. Some accommodations is fitted with a seating area and cable TV.

In the landscaped gardens, Vila Vita Parc offers several pools. The hotel also offers an on-site nursery and a children’s play park.

Vila Vita’s Spa features 12 treatment rooms, 1 yoga garden pavilion and the Hypoxi Studio offering revolutionary body sculpting techniques. A gym is available as well and sports activities on-site include mini golf and a tennis court.

With 12 restaurants and 6 bars, the food offered varies from local Portuguese seafood dishes to Asian cuisine. Vila Vita Parc features a wine cellar stocked with fine wines.

Real Marina Hotel & Spa’s stylish rooms feature a modern interior decorated with wooden furniture and carpeted floors. All rooms have a mini-bar, flat-screen cable TV, and an private bathroom. Some rooms have sea views.

Guests can relax at the Real Spa Therapy, which features 10 treatment rooms, a hot tub, a sauna, and a Turkish bath, all available at an extra charge. Real Marina’s Health Club offers a gym and an aerobics room with natural light.

Real Marina Hotel’s 2 restaurants serve local and international gourmet dishes, including fresh seafood. The 2 bars offer a wide variety of drinks and light snacks.

The islands of Armona, Culatra and Farol with its sandy beaches can be reached in 15 minutes with the nearby regular ferries. Vilamoura is at 22 mi from the hotel. Faro International Airport is 8.7 mi from the Real Marina Hotel & Spa.

name: Cascade Wellness Resort
description:
Set among gardens in a stunning cliff-top with an outdoor pool, Cascade Wellness Resort overlooks the Atlantic Ocean and the nearby Porto de Mós Beach. It features a full spa with beauty and massage treatments, hot tub and sauna.

The resort offers you a hotel, apartments and independent villas. The hotel is divided into five individually decorated wings, each reflecting the expeditions of Portuguese navigators across four continents – Europe, Africa, Asia and South America, which is reflected in the tasteful décor of the rooms and suites.

With 3 restaurants and 2 bars, the offer varies from international haute cuisine to the richness of Portuguese gastronomy and regional products.

The self-contained apartments and villas include spacious lounges and dining areas, as well as a fully equipped kitchen. WiFi access is free in all accommodations options and there is also free underground parking. The Cascade Wellness Resort features a Spa with 4 treatment rooms and outdoor heated pool, a state-of-the-art gym, kids club, 2 football pitches, 2 tennis courts and a gaming room.

Located within a 30-minute walk from Dona Ana Beach and Ponta da Piedade Lighthouse. Porto de Mós beach is 2953 feet, Boavista Golf Course is 1.9 mi away and Faro International Airport is 56 mi away.

name: Grande Real Santa Eulalia Resort & Hotel Spa
description:
Located in Albufeira, Algarve, the 5-star Grande Real Santa Eulalia Resort & Hotel Spa features direct access to the Santa Eulália Beach, 4 outdoor swimming pools plus 3 for children and a Thalassotherapy Spa with specialized staff.

The Grande Real Santa Eulália includes accommodations that will fit every families’ need. Each room, suite or apartment comes with air conditioning, digital TV and a balcony.

Guests may prepare their own meals if they are accommodated on a self-catering unit. Alternatively there are 3 restaurants on site which offer a variety of options to guests from Portuguese to International cuisine. In the evening guests may relax at one of the on-site bars. In addition there are 3 pool bars serving refreshments and snacks.

The Real Spa Therapy includes 17 treatment rooms, a dynamic seawater pool with thermal Thalasso Circuit for adults, massage rooms, relaxation areas, a sauna, a cocoon, a hammam, a gym and other wellness facilities such as a seasonal heated indoor pool for families with serene water, hydrotherapy benefits and a playful environment. The use of the wellness facilities is subject to conditions that require consultation under the "Fine Print" section. The Realito Kids Club offers music, games and entertainment for children of various ages. 

During summer guests can unwind at the Le Club Algarve disco open July and August featuring sushi and steakhouse in their culinary offer. Tasty handmade fresh pizzas cooked to perfection in an artisan brick oven are also available from June to September at the on-site Pizzeria Artigianale whose informal and welcoming atmosphere, including outside seating, make it ideal for family dinners.

Grande Real Santa Eulalia Resort & Hotel Spa provides free parking outdoor or in subterranean garages. Balaia Golf Course is 0.6 mi away, the Albufeira Old Town area is 2.9 mi away while the lively Oura Strip is just 1.1 mi away. The extensive Falésia Beach is 2.1 mi away and Faro International Airport is 22 mi away.

Luxurious amenities include 2 outdoor pools amid lush gardens, a hot tub and massage treatments. For children, Algarve Casino Hotel features a children's playground and a games room.

Guests can keep fit at the fitness center and, then, unwind in the sauna or Turkish bath. During the summer, water activities can be enjoyed at the beach, steps away from Hotel Algarve Casino. The elegant Amendoeiras Restaurant serves regional and international dishes made using fresh, local products. Zodíaco Snack Bar offers snacks and light meals by the pool.

Silves and Lagos are both less than 19 mi from Algarve Casino Hotel. Alto Golf Course is 1.9 mi away from the property.

name: Wyndham Grand Carvoeiro Algarve
description:
The Wyndham Grand Carvoeiro Algarve is an elegant 5-star hotel perched atop the cliffs of Carvoeiro, offering stunning views of the Atlantic Ocean and just a short walk from Vale de Centeanes Beach. Surrounded by some of the Algarve's most iconic coastal landscapes, the hotel offers a perfect retreat for those seeking tranquility, comfort, and proximity to nature.

The hotel has 134 spacious and contemporary rooms and suites, ranging in size from 92 ft² to 164 ft². All units include a private balcony with sea or garden views, air conditioning, LED TV with cable channels, high-speed Wi-Fi, mini-bar, coffee maker, and private bathroom with quality toiletries.

During their stay, guests can enjoy a variety of gastronomic experiences. The Aura Restaurant features Mediterranean-inspired cuisine with Middle Eastern and North African influences, while the Buffet Restaurant serves breakfast and dinner with a diverse selection of international and regional dishes. The enSEAda Bar offers signature cocktails in an elegant setting, and the Pool Bar serves refreshing drinks and light meals during the warmer months.

For leisure and well-being, the hotel features two outdoor swimming pools, a children's pool, a heated indoor pool, and a gym.

The Sal Maré Spa invites guests to a relaxing experience inspired by the essence of the Algarve. Facilities include a sauna, Turkish bath, sensory shower, jacuzzi, ice fountain, and four treatment rooms where rituals and massages are performed using the mineral energy of Atlantic salt, citrus aromas, and local ingredients to restore balance between body and mind.

The Wyndham Grand Carvoeiro Algarve's privileged location allows for easy exploration of some of the region's most iconic attractions, including the village of Carvoeiro, the Seven Hanging Valleys Trail, the Benagil Cave, and several renowned beaches. Faro International Airport is approximately 37 mi from the hotel.

name: Algarve Marriott Salgados Golf Resort & Spa
description:
The luxurious 5-star Algarve Marriott Salgados Golf Resort & Spa is next to the Salgados Golf and features scenic ocean views. The hotel features 3 outdoor swimming pools, a SPA & Wellness Center as well as restaurants and bars with panoramic views.

The modern rooms at the Algarve Marriott Salgados Golf Resort & Spa feature a private entrance, bathroom, flat-screen cable TV and a mini-bar. Some rooms also feature a balcony and views over the ocean and the golf course.

Guests can enjoy local and international cuisine in one of the property’s à la carte restaurants. The restaurants feature plenty of natural light and offer views over the property, the golf course and the ocean. Breakfast is served each morning in the bright dining rooms. A snack bar is available, for lighter meals.

Also featured are lounge bars, where refreshing drinks are served. The outdoor swimming pools feature sun loungers and a terrace, where guests can quietly relax following a swim. The Spa & Wellness center is accessible for a surcharge, the SPA can be used by people over 16 years of age. The Spa & Wellness center features a heated indoor swimming pool, Turkish bath and a sauna. Massages are also available, at a surcharge. The hotel also features a state-of-the-art business center. Free WiFi access is available in public areas.

It is a 2-minute walk from the famed Salgados Golf, with its green 18-hole courses. Salgados Beach is a 5-minute drive away. The Albufeira city center is a 16-minute drive and the  Algarve Marriott Salgados Golf Resort & Spa is a 29-minute drive from the famous cliff-surrounded Falésia Beach.

The Faro International Airport is a 40-minute drive away from the property.

Featuring a terrace with unique views of the lush gardens, the Lusitano Restaurant serves signature dishes from the Executive Chef Gerhard Poz. After a dip in the pool, guests can enjoys snacks and cocktails from the Ria Pool Bar.

Ria Park Hotel has a free health club with an indoor pool, a hot tub, a gym and a Turkish bath. A Spa is available at an extra fee for massages and treatments. Staff at the reception can organize activities such as horse-riding, bird-watching and cycling tours.

name: Pine Cliffs Hotel, a Luxury Collection Resort, Algarve
description:
This 5-star hotel has a stunning cliff-top location above Portugal’s longest beach, Praia da Falésia. It features luxury spa facilities and a seasonal water sports center.

All of the beautifully decorated rooms and suites at Pine Cliffs Hotel include LCD TVs. All rooms also include furnished balconies with resort, garden or sea views.

The air-conditioned accommodations at the hotel features private bathrooms with hairdryer and free toiletries, flat-screen cable TV, mini-bar and a balcony.

description:

The region is popular for cycling and hiking. The property offers a shuttle service to Salir for guests hiking the Via Algarviana. The nearest airport is Faro Airport, 22 mi from the property. Private parking is free.

name: Occidental Faro
description:
Located in downtown Faro just a 5-minute walk from the train station and the bus terminal, this modern hotel overlooks the old town, marina and the Ria Formosa Natural Park. Free WiFi is available throughout the hotel.

Occidental Faro offers spacious rooms filled with natural light, some of which open onto a balcony. All rooms come with a TV with cable channels and a mini-bar. The private bathrooms include free toiletries.

On the rooftop of the Hotel, in the BHeaven Faro restaurant, a fresh and varied breakfast buffet is served daily. Lunches, snacks and dinners are also served here, always with an impressive view over the Ria Formosa. The Hotel has half-board, if you wish to ensure your meals at the time of booking

The Faro Old Town is just a 3-minute walk away. Here guests can visit the Sé Cathedral and the Archaeological Museum. The pedestrian shopping streets of Faro's downtown are around the corner and Faro International Airport is 4.3 mi away.

During Summer, Occidental Faro provides a free shuttle service to its Beach Club, in Praia de Faro (5.6 mi from the Hotel). This service is subject to availability and your reservation must be made during check-in at the hotel. There is also a boat service, at an additional cost, to the pristine beaches of Ilhas Deserta, Farol and Culatra, allowing a unique experience through the preserved channels of the Ria Formosa Natural Park.

description:
Located in the green surroundings of the Costa Vicentina Natural Park, the Memmo Baleeira offers an outdoor pool with magnificent Atlantic Ocean views and rooms with private balconies.

The historical center of Sagres is 656 feet away and it takes a 5-minute walk to reach both Tonel and Martinhal Beach. The Fortress of Sagres can be reached in a 5-minute drive.

For children the hotel has a Kid’s club. The Memmo Baleeira also offers help in arranging various outdoor activities for its guests, including surfing, diving, biking and golf.

name: Luz Beach Apartments
description:
Located beachfront in Praia da Luz, the Luz Beach Apartments offer self-catering accommodations less than 1-minute walk to the beach over a traffic free promenade. Free WiFi is available in all apartments.

Luz Beach Apartments consists of of two rows of apartments right in front of the beach. The Sea Front apartments are on the front row and have uninterrupted beach and sea views. The Sea View apartments are located along the back row and overlook the sea from above.

All apartments except the Ground Floor Lighthouse Studio have furnished balconies with sea views. The Lighthouse studio has no sea or beach views as in on the ground floor and adapted for those with mobility issues. Instead there is a small walled courtyard with outside dining.

Several restaurants, cafés and bars serving local and international cuisine are within a 2-minute walk away from the Luz Beach Apartments. The bus stop and taxi rank are a short walk away as are the supermarkets, pharmacy and bank.

Guests can relax on the south facing terrace, head down to the beach with the beach picnic cooler box, beach parasol and body surf board all provided free of charge, choose a book from the library or take a cliff top walk. Other activities include dolphin safari trips, grotto cave trips, kayaking, water parks, surf lessons, jeep safaris, deep-sea fishing and golf.

There is a communal children's toy box full of beach toys for all children to use while on holiday at The Luz Beach Apartments. Sofa beds and children's fold away beds are available at an extra charge. Free public parking is available in front of the apartment complex.

name: Vila Gale Albacora
description:
Vila Galé Albacora is a 4-star resort, set in a rehabilitated tuna fishing camp among Ria Formosa Natural Park. It is close to the Island of Tavira and a 15-minute drive from Faro Airport. The property offers free WiFi.

All rooms and suites of this eco hotel are former houses, workshops and warehouses that have been comfortably furnished and renovated offering stunning views of the natural park. Each guest room has its own furnished patio area, which is close to the resort’s gardens.

For meals, guests can chose from buffet and à la carte dining options. The resort’s Restaurant Versátil serve Portuguese cuisine. Guests also enjoy a selection of Alentejo wines and cocktails.

Facilities include a heated indoor pool, a large outdoor pool, a spa and wellness center, and a children’s playground. The recovered on-site chapel offers the perfect scenery for weddings and christenings. The former school is now a modern kids' club. The pier of the property offers boat access to the pristine beaches of Tavira's Island.

Vila Galé Albacora is close to many historic buildings and long beaches. Guests can discover the nearby village of Luz de Tavira that has been a place of pilgrimage for many centuries.
